## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the feature or workflow.

## Ableton Live Reference
Describe how this feature functions in Ableton Live 12 (or how LiveCraft can exceed it).

## Proposed Implementation Details
Technical perspective on how this should be integrated into `livecraft-core`, `livecraft-dsp`, or `livecraft-gui`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Automated tests covering new logic
- [ ] No allocations on audio thread
- [ ] Verified via GUI / CLI
